description: Source file implementing logging functionalities including exception dumping, system file logging, and registration of log categories within the Thunder::Logging namespace.

classes.name: Instantiation
classes.description: Registers log categories (Crash, Startup, Shutdown, Fatal, Error, ParsingError, Notification) upon static initialization.

classes.name: ExceptionCatcher
classes.description: Handles exceptions in threads, dumping exception info when an exception occurs.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: Logs unhandled exceptions and call stack information.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: Logs system information from /proc files and process status.
